annotation.bound_parties_text: Provincial transport authorities and the operating and managing entities of main freight nodes (plus rail, port, and logistics enterprises, which are encouraged) are directed to implement the plan.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: 省级交通运输主管部门要深化认识，将打通多式联运堵点卡点作为完善现代化综合交通运输体系、降低全社会物流成本的重点任务予以推进
annotation.dates_quote: 实施多式联运攻坚 打通堵点卡点行动方案（2026—2030年）
annotation.robot_provision_quote: 配置智能卡口、远程控制龙门吊、无人集卡、自动分拣、AGV机器人等数智化设备。
